## Personality

John Meredith is characterized by his shyness and aloofness, though he possesses the heart of a boy and feels comfortable around Mrs. Blythe. He is also deeply absent-minded, frequently becoming so absorbed in his intellectual pursuits that he becomes entirely lost to the world, his family, and his parish.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P37](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0037)_

## History

In his youth, John Meredith was known as Jack. Later in life, while staying up all night reading, he reflected on his late wife Cecelia and his children. After meeting [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) by a sacred spring in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and walking her home, he began visiting her house. He eventually suffered a confrontation with Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md), who berated him for neglecting his children after he refused her demand to adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md). ## Quotes

> “I thank you for your kind intentions, Mrs. Davis,” said Mr. Meredith with a gentle, final, quite awful courtesy, “but I cannot give you my child.”
>
> — John Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P21](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0021)

> "On a calm day I fall into day dreams. No doubt you know my reputation, Miss West. If I cut you dead the next time we meet don’t put it down to bad manners. Please understand that it is only abstraction and forgive me—and speak to me."
>
> — John Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P23](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0023)

> "What a view—what an outlook! At times I feel stifled down there in the Glen. You can breathe up here."
>
> — John Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P21](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0021)

> "A day when there is no wind seems to me dead. A windy day wakes me up."
>
> — John Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P23](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0023)

> "I gave you your little scolding—and you were all penitent—and I forgave you."
>
> — John Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P20](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Carl](../character/carl.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carl--john-meredith.md)

John Meredith is Carl's father, though he frequently suffers from deep guilt over neglecting his motherless children while lost in his theological studies. Their relationship involves moments of domestic discipline, such as when John intends to whip [Carl](../character/carl.md) for a mischievous prank involving Mrs. Carr's buggy. However, John finds himself unable to go through with the punishment after looking into his son's eyes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P15](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0015), +11 more_

### [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ellen-west--john-meredith.md)

John Meredith and [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) are good friends who converse easily on topics such as European politics and [German](../codex/factions.md#german) militarism. However, significant tension arises when John seeks to marry Ellen's sister, [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md). [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) fiercely refuses to release [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) from a promise made ten years prior never to marry, forcing [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) to send John a cold refusal that leaves him heartbroken.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P12](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P19](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0019), +16 more_

- Friend of — good friends who share conversations and humor  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008)</sub>

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--john-meredith.md)

John Meredith is Faith's father, though his intense absorption in his studies often leaves him feeling remorseful for neglecting her and his other children. [Faith](../character/faith.md) admires the people in her father's life, warmly praising [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to him, while John supports her in turn, as seen when he approves of [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) fighting a local bully to defend Faith's honor.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P88](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0088), +9 more_

- Parent of — daughter  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P88](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0088), +1 more</sub>

### [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-meredith--rosemary-west.md)

John Meredith is deeply in love with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), viewing her as the only woman for him and proposing marriage to her. Though [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) loves him in return, she is initially forced to send him a painful refusal due to a solemn vow made to her sister. Their romantic prospects are later revived when [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md), resulting in a note that restores John's spirits.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P1](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P28](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0028), +6 more_

### [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-meredith--una-meredith.md)

John Meredith is the father of [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), whom he loves deeply, refusing an abrupt demand from Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md) to adopt her. His tendency to get lost in his studies often leads to oversight of her wellbeing, leaving him guilt-ridden when she faints from fasting. [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) cares deeply for his happiness in return, even overcoming her fear of gaining a stepmother to intervene with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) on his behalf.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), +5 more_

- Parent of — daughter  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), +3 more</sub>

### [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-meredith--walter-blythe.md)

John Meredith and [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) are close friends who share unreserved conversations. John offers Walter moral support and approval after Walter wins a schoolyard fight to defend John's daughter [Faith](../character/faith.md).
